fusions.name: Burst the Cap
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. The blow deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Rot Through
fusions.desc: A rotting blow that deals 16 damage, leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and has a 50% chance to leave it [Diseased] for 10 seconds. Your afflictions on it then spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Swell Overnight
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises 25% for 20 seconds.

fusions.name: Creeping Mass
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 8%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
